data.title: 埃塔 · 古代遗迹的密纹解读
data.description: 古代遗迹深处，埃塔举着拓印纸贴在刻满密纹的石壁上。别人要研究三个月的古代文字，她看一眼就打着哈欠说出了大意。
data.location: ancient ruins chamber with rune-covered stone walls, fallen pillars and dust in light shafts
data.action: 举着拓印纸贴在石壁上，打着哈欠轻松解译出古代遗迹密纹
data.lighting: 遗迹裂缝漏下的光柱与尘埃
data.promptProse: Deep inside a shadowed ancient stone chamber strewn with toppled pillars, Eta stands in her dusty explorer shorts, sturdy boots, and field backpack holding a sheet of charcoal rubbing paper flat against a rune-carved wall. Suppressing a lazy yawn with droopy eyes, she deciphers months of forgotten script at a single glance. Slanted shafts of daylight pierce cracks in the ruined ceiling, lighting drifting dust motes across the weathered carvings.
data.animaCaption: Holding a rubbing sheet flat against a rune-carved stone wall inside the ancient ruins, Eta stifles a sleepy yawn while effortlessly reading the script. Shafts of daylight stream through cracked masonry, catching drifting dust motes around her explorer gear.
